notes.title: Endless Mode
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added a new gameplay mode: Endless Mode
[*]Adjusted some card functions
[*]Fixed some bugs in items and processes
[/list]
Dear players, it's been a long wait. The Endless Mode, originally planned to be released in July, was delayed for so long due to some personal reasons of the project team. After the completion of the Endless Mode, all the game content originally planned to be released has been completed. The subsequent game will make some improvements based on the current game content and release the official version this year. Thank you to all players for continuing to support our project team.

notes.title: Updated on March 17th
notes.notes:
Updated new game character - Nuchou
Updated cards and treasures related to the Nuchou
Updated new main storyline and hidden levels
Fixed some bug issues

The testing of the new game character, the Nuchou, has finally been completed. Personally, I feel that the difficulty level of the new character is slightly higher than the first three characters. I don't know what everyone will think. In addition, along with the new characters, some main storylines and hidden levels have been updated. Through these storylines and hidden levels, we are finally able to construct a relatively complete storyline for the game. We hope everyone enjoys the ending of this story, and we welcome everyone to join the community or leave comments to continue providing us with valuable feedback. In April May, the game will continue to enrich its gameplay and launch a third game mode. See you next time for updates.

notes.title: Challenge Mode Is Opening
notes.notes:
The challenge mode is finally here for everyone. In the new challenge mode, we specialize the initial conditions and scene factors of the game, allowing players to have a different gaming experience than the story mode. And after completing the challenge, players can unlock new cards, treasures, and initial attributes, making them more adept in subsequent battles. In addition, due to the manpower and energy constraints of the project team, this game will not be updated too frequently. If you find any bugs that affect the game experience, please join the game group to discuss with the project team. Finally, the game is expected to update with the last new character in March. Stay tuned.

notes.title: 12.19 Update log
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added an optional initial character - Fuxi
[*] Added cards and treasures related to Fuxi characters
[*] Adjusted the passive abilities of the characters Shen Nong and N ü wa, and now their initial abilities have been improved.
[*] Optimized the mechanism of some bosses and reduced the overall difficulty of the game
[*] Fixed a large number of game bugs
[/list]


Sorry players, the game hasn't been updated for a long time.The new character Fuxi was actually completed in October, but there were too many bugs. The project team tested it continuously for a long time, and finally there are no fatal issues with the version now (of course, there are still some small problems that haven't been completely identified. Players are welcome to provide them to the project team). Although the progress is slow and arduous, the project team will not give up halfway and will definitely persist in completing the game. Finally, we would like to thank all the players for their feedback and assistance. We plan to launch a new challenge mode in January 2024 (which we have already done halfway through), and release the fourth ranked character and related content in the first half of 2024. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Version 1.0 of "Nine Territories Legends—the Sun Disaster" was launched
notes.notes:
After a period of testing and frantic bug fixing by the project team, "Nine Territories Legends—the Sun Disaster" has finally been officially launched today.
The current game content includes
1. 2 available characters: Shennong and Nuwa
2. 5 game chapters
3. almost all props and cards
4. 10 challenge difficulties
Although currently lots of bugs has been fixed by the project team, there are still existing some bugs that have not been fixed or discovered. Players who care about this can wait for a more stable version before purchasing. Purchased players can provide us with bugs they’ve discovered in the comment section or QQ community; and they will receive gratitude and rewards from the project team. At last, the project team's Bilibili account: Mufan Game Gua Association will soon start a game activity for activation code drawing. Welcome to follow and participate.

notes.title: Free Testing Unlocked
notes.notes:
After six months of internal testing and careful preparation, "Nine Territories Legends—the Sun Disaster" is finally about to be unlocked for public testing. You all are welcomed to experience our game for free. Please leave your valuable feedback in the comments section or join the QQ group 674689766 to exchange experience and ideas, helping us improve game quality and play-ability. We sincerely hope to bring you a better gaming experience in the official version. Friends who like our games can also follow our Bilibili account: 木凡游戏瓜总. We will have occasional live broadcasts of the game, and there will also be lottery activities such as getting the game for free from time to time.

In this free test, we have unlocked the following content:

1. Chapter 1-3 of the game

2. Content related to Shennong Role

3. Neutral cards and props
